answer_result.answer: Yes. Calvin says performing live always fuels his soul and that concerts are what he lives for, so he would likely enjoy performing at the Hollywood Bowl.

question.question: Would Calvin enjoy performing at the Hollywood Bowl?

Calvin: That's so inspiring, Dave. You find purpose in transforming things – like when you create something new or collaborate with others. We're both making something great out of nothing, it's amazing, right?

- The 2023-10-19 conversation continued: Calvin announced he's actually going to Tokyo in November 2023 ("next month") after the tour ends, sharing a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background — "Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like [that]. What a great view!"; Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's great to hear!" and asked any specific spots in Tokyo Calvin is really excited to check out; Calvin: Shibuya Crossing — "like Tokyo's Times Square" — and he's "excited to explore Shinjuku," plus "amazing food there, can't wait to try it again!" — sharing a photo of Shibuya Crossing at night (a crowd of people with umbrellas in the rain) — "that's amazing!"; Dave: "Shibuya and Shinjuku are cool spots! - On 2023-10-23, caught up with Calvin, picking back up a chat they'd had "the other day" about fame and its impact on relationships (a chat not otherwise recorded in this memory): asked how the tour with Frank Ocean is going — "It must be awesome but it must have its own struggles too" — and how Calvin juggles his job plus his personal life; Calvin: the tour's been incredible — performing and connecting with the crowd energizes him — but fame has its own challenges and balancing everything is tough [S25T1][S25T2]. Dave asked how he manages and whether he ever feels overwhelmed; Calvin: he takes it one day at a time, but it can get overwhelming with so many demands — still, he enjoys what he does so he pushes on [S25T3][S25T4]. Dave asked for strategies that help Calvin manage everything; Calvin: having a strong support system is really helpful — his friends and team keep him on track — and Dave agreed that having people who understand and support you is really important [S25T5][S25T6]. Dave then told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own — and that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed, and asked Calvin how he stays informed; Calvin: staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-23 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7][S25T8]. The conversation then turned to art: Dave said "Art is amazing how it reflects the world" and asked whether anything had caught Calvin's eye lately and made an impact on his music; Calvin: yes — recently he's been really inspired by the struggles that people go through, and it's made him dig deeper into his music to try to capture those feelings [S25T9][S25T10]. Dave asked whether using his music to share experiences and feelings is cathartic for him; Calvin: it's a way for him to express himself and work through his emotions — "like my own form of therapy" (Calvin's details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T11][S25T12]. Dave said he gets it — cars give him an outlet to express himself, "like a little oasis of calm," and working on one is "like I'm connecting back with myself" — and that the music helps too; he shared a photo of his garage (a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall — "a little dirty, but everything is in its place"; details in ## Car maintenance shop) [S25T13]. Calvin: "Looking cool — what made you start working on cars?"; Dave: ever since he was ten he's been fascinated with how machines work — he found an old car in a neighbor's garage, asked if he could fix it, and that's when his love for car engineering began — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S25T14][S25T15]. Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life." and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is currently working on another project [S25T16]; Dave answered in the continuation of the chat: "Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector" (the 2022 restoration — see ## Classic cars), "Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge!" — sharing a photo of his new project car (a black car parked in a parking lot — "Take a look at this wonderful car!") [S25T17]. Calvin: "Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?" — Dave: it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off [S25T18][S25T19]. Calvin: details "can really make a difference" and are what makes something great — "like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car" [S25T20]; Dave: paying attention to details "makes a big difference, whether it's in music or with vehicles" — little things can make a big impact [S25T21]. Calvin: without those details it's just average, and as an artist he wants to create something extraordinary — sharing a photo of his record (a silver disc in a black frame on a table; Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T22]; Dave: he loves the attention to detail in Calvin's work — "it makes it extra special. The chat then turned to concerts: Dave, glad that Calvin liked his garage, said the good times he's had at concerts last month (~September 2023 — e.g., the Boston rock concert ~2023-09-09/10, see ## Music) remind him that "music has a way of connecting us and making memories" — "Take a look at this picture, the atmosphere was amazing!" [S25T25][S25T26][S25T27][S25T28][S25T29]; Calvin: "It's a rush connecting with everyone. That feeling is unbeatable! Wishing you a harmonious day ahead, my friend!" Dave: "That's great, Calvin. We both have discovered something that brings us fulfillment. It's a fortunate thing for us." [S26T10].
